channel.title: Khaqan Shaheen: articles, tutorials and notes
channel.description: ERP, AI in production, infrastructure and IT leadership, written by Khaqan Shaheen, Head of IT in Dubai.

item.title: Why every AI agent I run sits behind a human queue
item.description: Because a language model is confidently wrong in a way a scanner never is, every agent I run creates records for a person to check and none of them post or pay.

item.title: Why I published my case studies without numbers
item.description: Because a number I cannot show how I measured is worse than no number; the scope is honest, and measured figures will be added once I have measured them.

item.title: What running my own venture taught me about corporate IT
item.description: Paying the bill yourself, watching what customers do on a booking page, a pipeline that stops silently and search traffic answering back changed how I run IT.

item.title: What OCR gets wrong on supplier bills
item.description: OCR on supplier bills fails on handwritten totals, stamps over numbers, multi-page bills, duplicates and currency; the fix is validation and a review queue.

item.title: What I check the week before a factory opens
item.description: Two links with a tested failover, the company and warehouse in the ERP with local tax and numbering, printers on the floor, every user logged in once, and a restore.

item.title: The month-end test for ERP health
item.description: If six sites can close the month from the same ERP records without a spreadsheet, the ERP is healthy; a spreadsheet at month end means a record is missing.

item.title: Odoo: how to stop two work orders being booked on the same machine at the same time
item.description: Add a server-side overlap constraint to Odoo 17 work orders, back it with a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint, and give planners a drill-through to the clashes.

item.title: How to write an llms.txt for a business website
item.description: An llms.txt is a short Markdown map of your site at /llms.txt with an H1, a one-line summary and linked sections. Here is the format and a full worked example.

item.title: How to check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews can read your website
item.description: Read robots.txt for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, fetch your homepage with curl as each bot, check the raw HTML, or run one Python audit script.

item.title: A WhatsApp AI sales agent that hands leads to your ERP: the architecture
item.description: A WhatsApp webhook, a session store keyed by phone, a model with four tools, a catalogue it cannot contradict, a hand-off rule and a lead created in Odoo by XML-RPC.

item.title: A PostgreSQL major-version upgrade with no unplanned downtime: the checklist
item.description: Upgrade a production PostgreSQL database to 16 using logical replication, a rehearsed cutover and a rollback window, then rebuild backups and monitoring.
